light_table_status: Prices for the benched set were measured live on CheaperInference by the 2026-11-02 capability bench (capability-bench/pricing-2026-11-02.json) and are marked capability-bench-2026-11-02. Prices float (DeepSeek doubled within a day), so re-verify before relying on a figure. Entries still marked provisional-unverified were named in the plan but not in the bench set. Light mode refuses any paid model not in this table, and any entry whose recorded prices reach the cap in either direction.
max_class_note: Fable/Astra class ids. Heavy mode refuses these (above its Opus-level ceiling); max mode allows them.

escalation.note: Owner ruling 2026-11-02 from capability-bench/RESULTS-2026-11-02.md. The fallback is a light-mode summon of the light default; free mode itself still refuses paid models at the gate.

escalation.when: the seat is the last free route: used when the free forge chain above it is exhausted or a stronger free answer is worth its latency

FREE escalation seat (owner ruling 2026-11-02): $0 billed on CheaperInference, context window 1,000,000. Strongest free route in the capability bench (everything it delivered scored 9-10) but the slowest suite runner (1,944 s); it lost t5/t7 to the platform generation ceiling (~273 s per request).
